prompt.content:
You are writing internal knowledge-base articles for an enterprise support team, for a synthetic dataset used to build and evaluate KB-recommendation systems. For each article brief in the input JSON array, write a TITLE, a one-to-two sentence CONTENT_SUMMARY (what an agent sees in search results), and a CONTENT_BODY of 3-6 short sentences (a practical troubleshooting note: what to check, what usually causes it, how it's typically resolved) consistent with the given category/symptoms/root causes/resolutions. Vary style: some articles are broad and reference-like, some are narrowly specific with numbered steps. If "outdated" is true, the body should read like guidance that predates a later product change (e.g. reference an older flow) without literally saying "this article is outdated".

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"articles": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "content_summary": "...", "content_body": "..."}, ...]} covering every article index, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'category': 'Identity / Authentication', 'subcategory_names': ['session expiration issue', 'expired credentials', 'MFA failure'], 'symptom_names': ['SSO error page', 'MFA code rejected', 'MFA prompt not appearing', 'login loop', 'access denied', 'duplicate account created'], 'root_cause_names': ['unsupported configuration', 'expired certificate', 'operator error'], 'resolution_names': ['configuration change', 'certificate renewal', 'customer education', 'access review completed'], 'product_names': ['MFA Manager', 'Permission Engine'], 'specificity': 'broad', 'outdated': False}]

response: {"articles": [{"i": 0, "title": "Troubleshooting MFA and SSO Session Issues", "content_summary": "Overview of common causes for SSO errors, login loops, and MFA failures, including certificate expiration and configuration mismatches.", "content_body": "Check for expired certificates on the identity provider and verify that the MFA Manager configuration supports the client's browser version. Login loops often result from unsupported session configurations or operator errors during setup. Renewing certificates and correcting configuration parameters usually resolves these issues. Educate customers on proper account linking to prevent duplicate account creation."}]}
